sentences.text: type=fact: For a floating-rate loan granted to an individual for a non-business purpose, a pre-payment charge is not permitted under the applicable UCB directions for this case, and the older RBI pre-payment directions are no longer in force on the as-of date.
type=fact: Clause 9.3 in the copy of the home loan agreement says the borrower shall pay a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure.
type=fact: That clause is not compliant with the applicable pre-payment rule because it requires a pre-payment charge where the rule says no pre-payment charge is permitted for this case.
